testCases.explanation: This test only initiates a top-up and checks that the wallet balance increases. It partially covers the credit_before_debit requirement by verifying the wallet is credited, but does not check that the funding source is debited only after crediting. It does not cover fx_lock or dual_approval requirements at all. It lacks assertions to verify the FX rate is locked at initiation, that the funding source debit happens after credit, or that dual approval is required for top-ups above SGD 10,000. It also does not test rollback on callback timeout. A concrete missed assertion is verifying the funding source is debited only after the wallet is credited. A concrete bug this test would miss is if the funding source is debited before the wallet is credited, violating transactional integrity.
missingAssertions: Verify FX rate is locked at top-up initiation
Verify funding source is debited only after wallet is credited
Verify top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval before settlement
Verify rollback occurs if payment provider callback times out after 5 seconds
testCases.hypothesizedBugThisWouldMiss: If the system debits the funding source before crediting the wallet, causing potential inconsistencies if a failure occurs, this test would not detect it because it does not verify the order of debit and credit operations.

suggestedReplacement.description: Verify wallet top-up with FX rate lock, credit-before-debit, and dual approval for large amounts
steps: Initiate top-up of SGD 500 and record FX rate at initiation
Verify wallet balance increases by SGD 500
Verify funding source is debited only after wallet credit
Initiate top-up of SGD 15,000
Verify system requests second-owner approval before settlement
Simulate payment provider callback timeout after 5 seconds
Verify transaction is rolled back and neither wallet nor funding source is affected
suggestedReplacement.expectedResult: FX rate is locked at initiation; wallet is credited before funding source is debited; top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval; transaction rolls back if callback times out
